description: Deploy static sites instantly — no account required

settings.name: API Key
settings.description: Optional. Without it, deploys are public and expire in 3 days. Your ShipStatic API key unlocks permanent deployments, custom domains, and account tools. One credential, two names: the console mints it as an API key (ship-...), and the variable that carries it is the token. Free at https://my.shipstatic.com/api-key.
